historical_record.description: The City Planning Commission approved, 7-0, a church of more than 6,000 square feet on the site (Motion 14100).
A vacant lot stood at the property.
The City Planning Commission took discretionary review and approved the project as modified.

The City Planning Commission endorsed the staff proposal to provide six units of off-site Below Market Rate housing at 2428 Bayshore Boulevard to meet conditions of approval for a new building at 1635 California Street.
